```{r}
source("init.R")

library(ggfortify); library(dplyr); library(sf); library(ggplot2)

wd <- set_wd()
```

## Importation des variables explicatives
```{r}
VariablesSite <- sf::st_read(paste0(wd$data, "derived/VariablesSite.shp"),
                             options = "ENCODING=UTF8")
VariablesSite <- VariablesSite %>%
  transform_VarSites() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Dnst_Cultures = `Dnst_Cultures `)
```

## Total
```{r}
Total <- sf::st_read(paste0(wd$data, "derived/Total.shp"),
                     options = "ENCODING=UTF8")
Total <- Total %>%
  transform_Total() %>%
  sf::st_join(VariablesSite)
```

```{r}
Total <- Total %>%
  dplyr::filter(technique_observation == "Vu") %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr:: mutate(cd_nom = as.numeric(cd_nom)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Code_10km, X_10km, Y_10km, 
                date, cd_nom, bdd_originale,
                Nom_paysage, Famille_paysage, 
                etat_biologique, 
                Ind_Diversite, Dnst_Cultures, Dist_EcotoneArbore,
                Dist_Littoral, Dist_Eau)
```

## Diro
```{r}
diro <- sf::st_read(paste0(wd$data, "derived/diro.shp"))

diro <- diro %>%
  sf::st_join(VariablesSite) %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(etat_biologique = "Trouvé mort : impact routier") %>%
  dplyr::rename(bdd_originale = bdd_rgn,
                cd_nom = cd_nm_t) %>%
  dplyr::select(Code_10km, X_10km, Y_10km, 
                date, cd_nom, bdd_originale,
                Nom_paysage, Famille_paysage, 
                etat_biologique, 
                Ind_Diversite, Dnst_Cultures, Dist_EcotoneArbore,
                Dist_Littoral, Dist_Eau)
```

## Export des 2
```{r}
Total_et_Diro <- rbind(Total, diro)
utils::write.csv(x = Total_et_Diro, 
                 file = paste0(wd$data, "derived/Total_et_Diro.csv"),
                 fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
```
